people.name: Josiah Vang
people.calling: I felt the call to ministry at the age of 18. I attended Crown Online in 2016, and after a few semesters, I decided to pursue a path in auto mechanics. I worked in the auto industry for six years. During that season, I was trying to make a name for myself as well as become wealthy. Finding self-sanctification led me to many dead ends in my career. I found myself longing for something more. After countless prayers and many people speaking into my life, I made the decision to go back to school and continue pursuing what God had started in my life. In the near future, I want to open a retreat center for boys and men to learn about being a godly man, husband, and son.
people.drink: I do not like coffee, but I enjoy White Cherry Gatorade
